note: Benchmark set for Zode CI (PRD REQ-050, REQ-062). Each upstream repository is mirrored at the pinned commit into zodeops/bench-<name>; the measured workflow differs from upstream only in runs-on (every job takes the runner input) and its trigger (workflow_dispatch only). Other workflow files are removed so nothing else runs. caddy is ci-bench's own workflow, kept as the first reference point.

repos.name: excalidraw
repos.why: Yarn monorepo install plus a Vitest suite, no cache: a pure cold install measure.

repos.name: alpine
repos.why: Browser end-to-end tests with Cypress: needs the browser system libraries a GitHub image carries.

repos.name: jquery
repos.why: Small Node version matrix with the setup-node npm cache, so cold and warm differ; short jobs make start time dominate.

repos.name: starlette
repos.why: pytest suite on five Python versions with uv and its cache: many sub-minute jobs, start time matters most.

repos.name: httpx
repos.why: The classic uncached pip install path across five Python versions, plus lint, docs build and a coverage gate.

repos.name: saleor
repos.why: The long suite (about 17 min on ubuntu-latest): Django pytest with -n logical in a python:3.12 container job with Postgres and Valkey service containers.

repos.name: fzf
repos.why: Go build and tests plus Ruby, apt packages (zsh, fish, tmux) and tmux integration tests: a parity check as much as a speed one.

repos.name: helm
repos.why: One Go job of about 5 min (unit tests, coverage, build) with the setup-go cache.

repos.name: nginx-proxy
repos.why: Docker-heavy: image builds plus docker compose integration tests, about 11 min per job.

repos.name: petclinic
repos.why: Maven build with the setup-java cache and Testcontainers (MySQL) tests that need Docker.

repos.name: caddy
repos.why: ci-bench's original side-by-side Caddy build (mod download, build, vet): the 12 Nov 2026 reference, 50 s on zode-4x8 against 82 s on ubuntu-latest.
